result:
I ran every query against its data file. Each answered what the task asks, except that I didn't check the Y5 tie-breaking by hand.

- **Keys as keywords:** The maps in Y4, Y8, Y12 and Y13 print their keys as keywords (`:ann`, `:db`), since qlang maps only take keyword keys. The names inside the arrays in Y6, Y11 and Y14 are real strings.
- **Y13:** A value containing a second `=` would be cut short. The file has none.

Y1: get /data/users | filter ~(query /profile/country "" | lower | eq "de") | count
Y2: get /data/users | filter ~(query /email null | ne null) | map ~(get /email | split "@" | last | lower) | distinct | sort
Y3: get /data/users | filter ~(query /active false | eq true) | map ~(query /profile/age null) | filter ~(type | eq ::number) | avg | round 1
Y4: filter ~(get /status | eq "open") | map ~(query /assignee null | if (eq null) ~("unassigned") ~(it)) | groupBy | map ~(count)
Y5: map ~(get {:id /id :c ~(query /comments [] | count)}) | sort ~(get [~(get /c | desc) /id]) | take 3 | map ~(get /id)
Y6: get [/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(entries) | flat | filter ~(get /1 | startsWith "^") | map ~(get /0 | toString) | distinct | sort
Y7: get {:name /name :major ~(get /version | split "." | first | toNumber) :depCount ~(get [/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(keys) | flat | distinct | count) :hasTest ~(get /scripts | has /test)}
Y8: lines | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(get /1 | eq "ERROR") | map ~(get /2) | groupBy | map ~(count)
Y9: lines | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(get /1 | anyOf ~(eq "WARN") ~(eq "ERROR")) | map ~(get /2) | distinct | sort
Y10: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split ",") | map ~(get {:c /1 :q ~(get /3 | toNumber) :p ~(get /4 | toNumber) :s ~(get /5 | trim | lower)}) | filter ~(get /s | eq "paid") | map ~(mulOf /q /p) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
Y11: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split ",") | map ~(get {:c /1 :q ~(get /3 | toNumber) :s ~(get /5 | trim | lower)}) | filter ~(get /s | ne "cancelled") | groupBy /c | map ~(map ~(get /q) | sum) | entries | map ~(get {:customer ~(get /0 | toString) :total /1}) | sort ~(get [~(get /total | desc) /customer]) | take 2
Y12: get /services | entries | filter ~(get /1 | query /enabled true | ne false) | map ~(get [~(get /0) ~(get /1 | query /port null | if (eq null) ~(8080) ~(it))]) | toMap
Y13: lines | map ~(trim) | filter ~(startsWith "DB_") | map ~(split "=") | map ~(get [~(get /0 | trim | drop 3 | lower | toKeyword) ~(get /1 | trim)]) | toMap
Y14: "the Quick brown fox jumps over the quick Dog and the lazy dog Fox" | split " " | map ~(lower) | groupBy | map ~(count) | entries | map ~(get {:word ~(get /0 | toString) :count /1}) | sort ~(get [~(get /count | desc) /word]) | take 3
